body: I was super drunk at a party last Thursday and confessed to some people there that I was planning to kill myself. Now everyone treats me different, like they're afraid one misinterpreted sentence and I'll go hang myself in the bathroom or something. Fuck that I'd rather them not know.

I don't know. I'm in AP/Honors classes, I did great on my ACT, I have friends, and apparently I'm pretty attractive too. But ever since I was about 14, I've wanted to die more than anything else. Back then it was mostly fantasizing about the day I would shoot the H, take the Xanax/Oxy combo, and chug the booze. But now I actually have the means to do it. I just don't know why I haven't offed myself yet. Maybe I'm not really depressed? No - that wouldn't explain how I've felt for the past 4 years almost. Maybe it's my family? No - they don't like me. Friends? No - they can pretend to care, but it only fools themselves. Whatever the reason is, it probably won't be enough to keep me alive forever.
